title: revamped the creature visuals based on this sub's feedbacks yesterday
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
I was told that the old version was too static and the creatures feel like animated cutouts. 

I am not sure if it is my prompt or Nano Banana being better now (I saw the Nano Banana 2 banner today), but the sprite quality seem to improved a lot. 

I couldn't get omni to generate videos for this game for some reasons (video policy?) so that was a bummer. 

In order to get the visuals to fit the gameplay better, I decided to just make every creature a floating creature. (it is also nice not having to generate walk cycles for each of them again)

another big change is just having a mature/young version of each creature instead of scaling them up and down. 

I also generated animation for the arena background. it is not a seamless loop so hopefully it is not jarring. 

It would be great if anyone can provide some gameplay feedback (I only have one last time) 

please help me cook lol, thanks for reading

comments.author: MeasIIDX
comments.body:
Nice on the shadows and floaty-ness!

I think a really nice touch you added is the crowd being animated as well. Looking good!

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: yeah, thanks for the suggestion from the last post.

comments.author: Dark_Death_Silumgar
comments.body:
Cool. I Like it.

One suggestion: maybe smooth out the round transitions? A noticeable countdown before the round ends would help. It might add to the flavors depending on how you do it.  
And when the menu pops up, maybe have it slide into position or animate in somehow, anything so it doesn't just snap into existence.

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I see. Yeah, that's doable. I will work on it in the next build. Thanks

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
hey thanks! I also just updated the demo today by adding some tutorial pages + some polishes. 

I would appreciate it if I can get some gameplay feedbacks, thanks!
